title: L-bracket

description.en: An L-shaped angle bracket of 4 mm stock, 25 mm wide: one leg lies flat on the XY plane and runs 40 mm along +X, the other stands up along +Z to a height of 30 mm, both legs measured to the outside of the corner, which is at the origin. The bracket runs from Y = 0 to Y = 25. Drive it by the variables leg_x, leg_z, thickness and width.
description.nl: Een L-vormige hoeksteun uit 4 mm materiaal, 25 mm breed: een been ligt plat op het XY-vlak en loopt 40 mm langs +X, het andere staat rechtop langs +Z tot 30 mm hoog; beide benen zijn gemeten tot de buitenkant van de hoek, die in de oorsprong ligt. De steun loopt van Y = 0 tot Y = 25. Stuur hem met de variabelen leg_x, leg_z, thickness en width.

variables.name: leg_x
variables.meaning: flat leg, outside length along X

variables.name: leg_z
variables.meaning: upright leg, outside height along Z

value: (leg_x * thickness * leg_x / 2 + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness * thickness / 2) / (leg_x * thickness + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness)
(leg_x * thickness * thickness / 2 + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness * (thickness + leg_z) / 2) / (leg_x * thickness + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness)

derivation: Split the L profile into the flat leg a x t and the upright leg above it, t x (b - t): A = a t + (b - t) t = 160 + 104 = 264 mm^2; V = A w = 6600 mm^3.
Area: two profile faces 2 A, plus the profile's perimeter times the width. The perimeter of an L whose sides are all along X or Z is 2 (a + b).
Centroid: the area-weighted mean of the two rectangles' centres, (a/2, t/2) and (t/2, t + (b - t)/2) in (X, Z); Y = w/2.
Faces: 6 profile edges swept, plus the two ends.
